distribution.method: exact static slot enumeration, duplicates retained as weights; no engine or Monte Carlo sample
distribution.familyAndOccupation: uniform over indexed slots within selected world/family; duplicate values carry multiple slots
distribution.denominator: all backgrounds randomized and occupation-generation eligible

defaultUnrestrictedAgeBranch.source: generate_stock:44..48; settings or overrides change this

standardOnDiskSeedScan.limitations: standard index only; not extra packs, saved engine arrays or observed discovery-route mixture

distribution.fullDiscoveryFormula: sum(P(actual discovery path) * single resolved candidate roll); do not report conditional model as live total discovery rate

recommendations.initial: narrow direct personal experience first; keep broader training candidates as review options
recommendations.overlap: occupation evidence before family training, no world-only roll; one person one roll, amazon+heroine not two draws
recommendations.traits: preserve nonzero combat trait, keep acquired path; no stacking
recommendations.chance: heroine-only 50% =>2.256% conditional model; direct four 20-25% =>1.583-1.979%; training-expanded nine 5-10% =>1.103-2.207%. These are proposed ranges, not approved values.
recommendations.classMapping: heroine->veteran strongest; assigning berserker/paladin by theme needs a design choice and must not claim unprovided rage/holy training history
recommendations.newRandomDiscoveries: apply at generation once after background is resolved, using existing enum field; no reload/shop revisit reroll
recommendations.fixedPresets: review named preset IDs individually; do not blindly randomize authored characters or overwrite skills/history
recommendations.existingSaves: no retroactive reroll; new generation can use new rule. Retroactive migration/provenance flags are separate scope, not proposed automatically
recommendations.structuralCost: newly generated one-time assignment can use existing field; no new persistent key required unless separately displaying innate/acquired provenance

limits: no new narrative or trait lore
static analytic distribution only; gameplay sample absent
candidate presence does not fix trait class mapping
seed parse exclusion does not establish any live game symptom
